website_summary.name: EcoSort Master
website_summary.description: The website features a clean, educational interface with a focus on teaching children about recycling through an interactive game.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a minimalist and child-friendly design with a pastel cyan background. The main content is centered within a rounded white card that contains the game instructions and interactive elements. The title "EcoSort Master" is prominently displayed at the top in bold teal font, accompanied by a recycling symbol. Below the title, there's a brief description of the game's purpose. The "How to Play" section lists the game rules and bin color codes using small, colorful circles for visual clarity. The input field for entering a player's name and the "Start Game" button are positioned at the bottom of the card. The overall design is simple, with a focus on readability and ease of use for children.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to enter their name and start an interactive recycling game. The game involves reading item names and dragging them to the correct recycling bin based on the provided color codes. Users can score points for correct answers and build a streak. The website also includes a disclaimer about agreeing to terms and privacy policies by playing the game. However, the current screenshot does not show the leaderboard or cartoon-style visuals mentioned in the instructions.
